rules.name: Daily Yield Validation
rules.description: Daily milk yield, collection volume, or feed weight must be recorded with positive numbers.
rules.recommendation: Enforce positive volume constraints and check date/shift consistency.

rules.name: Offline Milk Collection Sync
rules.description: Field milk collection from farmers must support offline mode with local queuing.
rules.recommendation: Queue offline collection records and sync with server once internet connectivity is restored.
